record.paper_title: Recent progress and open questions on the numerical index of Banach spaces
record.context_brief: Polynomial numerical index of Bochner spaces
record.original_question: Let X be a Banach space, let μ be a positive σ-finite measure, and let k > 2. Determine whether there is any general relationship between n^(k)(L_1(μ,X)) or n^(k)(L_∞(μ,X)) and n^(k)(X).

evidence.quote: Problem 40. Let X be a Banach space, µ a positive σ-finite measure and k > 2. Is there any relationship between n(k)(L1(µ, X)) (resp. n(k)(L∞(µ, X))) and n(k)(X)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a (real or complex) Banach space $X$, let $\mathcal{P}(^kX;X)$ denote the Banach space of continuous $k$-homogeneous polynomials $P:X\to X$ endowed with the norm $\|P\|=\sup_{\|x\|\le 1}\|P(x)\|$. The numerical radius of $P\in\mathcal{P}(^kX;X)$ is
$$v(P)=\sup\{|x^*(P(x))|:x\in X,\ x^*\in X^*,\ \|x\|=\|x^*\|=x^*(x)=1\},$$
and the polynomial numerical index of order $k$ of $X$ is
$$n^{(k)}(X)=\inf\{v(P):P\in\mathcal{P}(^kX;X),\ \|P\|=1\}.$$
For a positive $\sigma$-finite measure $\mu$ and a Banach space $X$, let $L_1(\mu,X)$ and $L_\infty(\mu,X)$ denote the usual Bochner spaces of $X$-valued integrable, respectively essentially bounded, measurable functions.

Fix an integer $k>2$. Determine whether there is any general relationship (e.g., an equality, or two-sided inequalities valid for every $X$ and every $\mu$) between $n^{(k)}(L_1(\mu,X))$ and $n^{(k)}(X)$, and analogously between $n^{(k)}(L_\infty(\mu,X))$ and $n^{(k)}(X)$.
artifact.category_tag: polynomial numerical index of Banach spaces
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution was found relating $n^{(k)}(L_1(\mu,X))$ or $n^{(k)}(L_\infty(\mu,X))$ to $n^{(k)}(X)$ for $k>2$. Existing literature treats related cases (e.g., $n^{(k)}$ for scalar $L_1(\mu)$, $C(K)$, and $c_0/\ell_1/\ell_\infty$-sums), but the vector-valued Bochner case for higher-degree polynomials appears to remain unresolved.

status_evidence.title: The polynomial numerical index of a Banach space
status_evidence.snippet: Studies polynomial numerical indices of C(K) and L_1(mu), and sums of Banach spaces, without resolving the Bochner-valued L_1(mu,X), L_infty(mu,X) case for k>2.
status_evidence.claim: Available results address scalar L_1 and C(K) cases and sums, but not the vector-valued Bochner case for k>2.
